# Movie Planner

> A fully static web client for movie-planner (the CLI that logs watched
> movies and syncs them to a CalDAV calendar) — browse, log, and edit your
> watch history from any browser, talking straight to your own CalDAV
> server with no account and no backend of this app's own.

There's no shared database and no server, of any kind, that ever sees your
CalDAV/OMDb/TMDb credentials — not even in transit. Only tested against
[Baikal](https://sabre.io/baikal/) as a CalDAV server so far.

## Docs

- [About](https://movie-planner.ryankes.eu/about/): what the app is and how it works.
- [Usage docs](https://movie-planner.ryankes.eu/docs/): connecting a CalDAV server, logging viewings, import/export, keyboard shortcuts.
- [Changelog](https://movie-planner.ryankes.eu/changelog/): release history.

## App

- [Calendar overview](https://movie-planner.ryankes.eu/calendar/): the watch history calendar view.
- [Log a viewing](https://movie-planner.ryankes.eu/log/): record a movie you watched.
- [Import viewings](https://movie-planner.ryankes.eu/import/): bulk CSV/JSON import.
- [Settings](https://movie-planner.ryankes.eu/settings/): CalDAV connection and app settings.
- [Missing data](https://movie-planner.ryankes.eu/missing-data/): viewings with incomplete metadata.
